payload.title: Add run-level spend budgets to Procedure
payload.description: As an operator running unattended agents, I want Procedure { budget = { max_cost_usd, max_total_tokens } } enforced across suspend and resume, so that a runaway agent cannot overspend. Done when: enforced before each agent turn from the checkpointed log, never double-counted on replay, documented in SPECIFICATION.md and DURABILITY.md, full suite green. Implementation is on branch claude/project-thread-4m64pi-spend-budgets. Not included: wall-clock caps, per-agent budgets, hooks (see ModelAttemptAuthority).
